personality_one_liner: An authoritative, clean workforce alignment platform bridging talent and industry with iOS-native clarity and precision.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native vertical rhythm with consistent padding and precise touch target alignment.

do's: Use glass blur on sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply translucent tinted base for foreground readability
dont's: Never blur form fields or entire screens
Avoid heavy drop shadows behind glass surfaces

screens.name: Auth & Role Selection
screens.purpose: Secure authentication and role selection for Trainee, Trainer, Employer, Government, and Admin.

states.empty: Please select your role and sign in.
states.error: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.

screens.layout: Clean centered card layout with role selector chips and secure input fields.

screens.name: Trainee Dashboard
screens.purpose: Comprehensive trainee command center showing career goals, skill-gap analysis, recommended courses, and active applications.

states.loading: Loading your skill profile and recommendations...
states.empty: No career goal set yet. Tap to configure your profile.
states.error: Unable to fetch your skill data. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with pinned header, hero skill summary card, quick status chips, and structured recommendation modules.

screens.name: Skill-Gap & Assessment
screens.purpose: Transparent skill proficiency scoring, gap analysis, and interactive assessment history.
screens.layout: Modular metric cards with progress bars and side-by-side gap breakdown.

screens.name: Employer & Job Matching
screens.purpose: Rule-based candidate matching, job posting management, and application tracking with privacy controls.

states.loading: Matching verified skills against employer requirements...
states.empty: No job postings or matches available.
states.error: Could not connect to employer matching engine.

screens.layout: Card list with match percentage badges, skill verification tags, and sticky action buttons.

screens.name: Government District Intelligence
screens.purpose: State and district workforce intelligence map, demand-supply indicators, and training capacity metrics.

states.empty: Select a state or district to view workforce analytics.
states.error: Failed to load government intelligence records.

screens.layout: Interactive map overview with side panel drill-down, demographic distribution charts, and DEMO/SAMPLE DATA badges.

screens.name: Admin Control & Audit
screens.purpose: Platform-wide user verification, role management, audit logging, and demo data administration.

states.loading: Loading system audit logs and pending verifications...

screens.layout: Tabular audit feed with filter controls and bulk verification actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all working backend models, database migrations, and authentication pipelines.
Implement the 5 role portals (Trainee, Trainer, Employer, Government, Admin) with robust role-based access control.
Ensure the shared Skill entity connects assessments, job postings, training courses, and government intelligence.
Clearly label all demonstration and sample datasets as DEMO/SAMPLE DATA.
Maintain high contrast and accessible touch targets (>= 44x44pt) across all mobile views.
